description: A mass on a spring: each trigger kicks it, and the output follows its position as it swings and settles

params.text: Sets the spring stiffness, 0 to 1 spread over a constant of 5 to 1000; higher settings swing faster
Scales the spring input from nothing to its full voltage before it is added to the spring knob, 0 to 1
Sets the damping, 0 to 1 spread over a constant of 0 to 10; at 0 the swing never dies away
Scales the damping input from nothing to its full voltage before it is added to the damping knob, 0 to 1
Sets how hard each trigger kicks the mass, 0 to 10; at 0 a trigger does nothing at all

inputs.text: A rising edge adds a kick to the mass's velocity, scaled back a little as the spring gets stiffer
Added to the spring knob after the attenuator, 10V covering the knob's whole range and the total clamped to it
Added to the damping knob after the attenuator, 10V covering the knob's whole range and the total clamped to it

outputs.text: Carries the mass's position, clamped to ±10V

notes: the mass rests at 0V and the output does not move until a trigger arrives
with damping at 0 the swing never dies away, and each further trigger adds to the motion already there

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.2:
0 to 10V · continuous · one channel only

a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
